item.divinefishing.divine_rod.desc: Unbreakable. The lure bites almost instantly.
item.divinefishing.judgment_blade.desc: Every hit strikes the target with lightning. Right click: three bolts from the sky.
item.divinefishing.void_orb.desc: Right click: opens a black hole that pulls in and crushes everything, then collapses.
item.divinefishing.chrono_hourglass.desc: Right click: stops time around you for 8 seconds.
item.divinefishing.meteor_staff.desc: Right click: rains meteors down on your target.
item.divinefishing.phoenix_heart.desc: Right click: full heal and a burst of flames. In your inventory, it cancels your death.
item.divinefishing.angel_feather.desc: Right click: fly for 90 seconds. Click again to land.
